presented_output_a: Customers with Enterprise accounts created after January 1, 2025, can restore archived workspaces. Recovery may take up to 48 hours.
presented_output_b: Only customers with Enterprise accounts created after January 1, 2025 can restore archived workspaces. Restoration may take up to 48 hours.

output_a.evidence: Clear and natural, but omitting “only” weakens the explicit exclusivity constraint.

output_b.evidence: Explicitly preserves Enterprise eligibility, the account creation date, archived workspace restoration, and the 48-hour maximum.

judgment.preference_evidence: B explicitly preserves the source’s “only” eligibility restriction; A merely identifies eligible customers without excluding others.
